comments.body: `Promise.all` was replaced with `promiseAll`, but this file has no import for it. The file has no `import` or `require` at all, and `promiseAll` appears only on this line. `handleOrderPlaced` is subscribed to `order.placed` (line 27), so every placed order throws `ReferenceError: promiseAll is not defined` here. Discount `usage_count` is then never incremented, and the event handler fails. Add `import { promiseAll } from "@medusajs/utils"`.
